name: frontend-a11y
description: Deep accessibility audit mapped to the Front-End-Checklist Accessibility category (95 rules). Offline Python stdlib static checks (structure, ARIA, headings, landmarks, tables, forms, media tracks, lists, CSS signals) plus a documented Playwright+axe-core runtime runner (contrast, focus order, live regions, modal traps, reflow) and manual screen-reader checks. Complements frontend-perfection, which covers only basic a11y.
author: best
